# Sinso

Sinso is the US-facing brand of Ningbo Sinso Printing Co., Ltd. (founded 1998), a precision color packaging manufacturer in Ningbo, Zhejiang, China. The factory runs 7-color ECG printing on a Heidelberg Speedmaster XL 75 (8-color, inline coater), covering approximately 80% of Pantone within ΔE 2.5, independently validated by CTV ECG certification. Certifications held: G7 Master Printer, GMI, ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001, FSC Chain of Custody (BV-COC-129082), SMETA, Disney FAMA, and CTV ECG. US coordination and project management at hello@sinso.us.

## Ordering facts

- MOQ: generally 3,000 units, though the exact minimum depends on the packaging structure
- Plate fees apply per design; orders split across several designs carry more setup cost than a single design at the same total quantity
- Lead time: approximately 6–10 weeks from brief to first production run, excluding ocean freight
- Shipping terms: EXW, FCA or FOB Ningbo
- Payment: T/T (bank wire) only; no letters of credit accepted
- New customers: deposit up front, balance due after final inspection and before shipment
- Established high-volume accounts: 30-day payment terms can be discussed

## Contact

hello@sinso.us — briefs, quotes, samples, and certification documentation. Response within 24 hours.
